capabilities: Render .fb2 files as formatted books with covers, chapters, footnotes, images and tables
List chapters of the active book in a side panel and jump to them
Remember reading position per book and restore it on reopen
Configure reader appearance such as theme, font, line height and drop caps
Detect and decode legacy encodings like windows-1251
disambiguation: Not a converter or importer; it only displays .fb2 files in place inside the vault.
extras: Zipped .fb2.zip files are not supported and must be unpacked first; the README also explains why the plugin does not claim the .zip extension.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or display .fb2 ebook files, so readers must use a separate app to view books stored in their vault.
summary: Reader that renders FictionBook (.fb2) ebook files in the vault as formatted books with a chapter table of contents and saved reading positions.
